questions.question: Shape s = new Circle(...); Which type controls whether s.radius is accessible?
questions.explanation: Compile-time member access is checked against the reference's declared type.

questions.question: Which implementation runs for an overridden instance method?
options: The first method in the file
questions.explanation: Dynamic dispatch chooses the most specific override on the runtime object.

questions.question: Why use @Override?
options: It asks the compiler to verify a true override
questions.explanation: The annotation catches spelling and signature errors.

questions.question: Overloading differs from overriding because overloading uses…
options: A different parameter list resolved at compile time
The same signature in a subclass only
questions.explanation: Overloading selects among distinct signatures; overriding replaces inherited behaviour.
